title: microfiber pillow cases
text: microfiber pillow cases. I purchased queen and king size, each a package of 12 pillow cases.  White.  They are microfiber so they wash and dry nicely and feel soft.  They won't last a lifetime, but they will last for some time.  They have not pilled or held stains.  So far, so good.  Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Glarea White Pillow Cases Queen Size- Bulk 12 Pack with Envelope Closure - Soft Microfiber Material for Comfortable Sleep, Sublimation and Air BnB Essentials
features: Valuable Bundle: Bulk pack of 12 pillowcases ensure you already have extra covers for pillows when required. These white cases are great essentials for hotels, air bnb or even for embroidery and sublimation.
Soft and Comfortable: Enjoy a cozy sleep on these microfibers soft pillowcases which are great to touch and feel. These are perfect partners after a tiring day at work!

Neat Look: Thoughtfully designed with envelope closure, now you do not need to worry about your pillows falling off while you sleep. It has no zipper, allowing you easy access to take them on and off for a comfortable experience.

Generously Sized: These Large pillowcases of standard queen size measure 20 x 30 inches to easily fit your queen pillow cases. You could easily match them with our 6 pack of fitted sheets and flat sheets for a complete look.

Easy care: Unlike cotton sheets, these microfiber pillowcases are fade, shrinkage, and wrinkle resistant. Ensure you wash them delicately using cold water with your hands or on a gentle cycle in the machine.
